name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with t(9;11)(p22;q23)
aliases: Acute Myelomonocytic Leukemia with MLL rearrangement

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of t(9;11)(p22;q23) translocation confirmed by cytogenetic or molecular testing
Bone marrow or peripheral blood blasts ≥20%
Immunophenotyping showing myeloid lineage markers (e.g., CD13, CD33, MPO positivity)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ≥20% myeloid blasts in bone marrow or blood plus confirmed t(9;11)(p22;q23) translocation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotyping, and cytogenetic/molecular findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Circulating immature myeloid cells detected on peripheral smear
searchTerms: immature white blood cells in blood

pathognomonic.symptomName: Bone marrow hypercellularity with myeloblast proliferation
searchTerms: bone marrow with too many immature blasts
excess immature blood cells in marrow
pale skin and tiredness from anemia
fatigue and pallor due to low red blood cells
low platelets causing bleeding in skin and mucous
thrombocytopenia causing mouth and skin bleeding
immune weakness with low white cells

occasional.symptomName: Bone pain due to marrow expansion

searchTerms: high temperature from cancer, not infection

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with neurological deficits
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to CNS involvement
lung problems from blood cell buildup

imaging: Chest X-ray may show leukostasis-related infiltrates
other: Immunophenotyping positive for myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, MPO)
Coagulation profile may show abnormalities if DIC present

distinguishingFeatures: Lymphoid rather than myeloid blast immunophenotype
Different clinical course and treatment protocols
Better prognosis compared to t(9;11) AML

redFlags: Signs of leukostasis (respiratory distress, neurological symptoms)
Severe bleeding or petechiae due to thrombocytopenia
references: Arber DA, et al. The 2016 revision to the World Health Organization classification of myeloid neoplasms and acute leukemia. Blood. 2016.
Döhner H, et al. Diagnosis and management of AML in adults: 2017 ELN recommendations from an international expert panel. Blood. 2017.
Orphanet: Acute myeloid leukemia with t(9;11)(p22;q23) - ORPHA:402017
